core: CWR v0.1 detector and local ridge repair retained

geometric_regularization.application: candidate local repair is blended with previous encoder by line search over alpha in {0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0}; choose candidate minimizing consensus loss + lambda_gram * normalized-Gram drift on the adaptation block
geometric_regularization.target: normalized Gram matrix of a recent trusted fused latent state
geometric_regularization.trusted_reference_update: if committed candidate lowers consensus loss and its Gram drift from current trusted reference is <= running 60th percentile, set trusted reference to current post-repair latent
